verdict_reason: The two paper-defined quantities are exact. _self_bleu_single is literally Texygen's SelfBleu.calc_bleu call (nltk sentence_bleu, uniform weights (1/4,)*4, SmoothingFunction().method1) with Texygen's own leave-one-out reference set from get_bleu_parallel: I re-fetched geek-ai/Texygen/utils/metrics/SelfBleu.py this pass and the head-to-head worst absolute difference over 60 random 6-completion sets is 0.000e+00. _distinct_n uses Li et al.'s total-generated-tokens denominator. The one objection I raised last pass was a LABELLING defect, and it is now fixed at the exported-key level: the three columns are mean_sampling_entropy_first_quarter / _last_quarter / sampling_entropy_collapse_delta, which is exactly what they measure (I re-measured on gpt2: support is exactly 50 at every position, 99.90% of the vocabulary is -inf, value 2.2054 nats against the model's own 4.3692 at T=1 and 3.0083 at T=0.8). Under the new names the entropy of the actual top-50/T=0.8 sampling distribution is a well-defined estimand that the code computes correctly; nothing remains that computes something other than what it claims.
comparable_reason: Split. The entropy family is BETTER than I credited last pass: because the top-50 warper renormalizes onto a support of exactly 50 for every model, the ceiling is log 50 = 3.912 regardless of vocabulary, so unlike a full-vocabulary entropy it carries no log(vocab) offset (gpt2 50257 and pythia 50304 both report onto the same 50-token support). Distinct-n and Self-BLEU remain tokenizer-dependent because they are scored over SUBWORD IDS while Li et al. and Zhu et al. define them over words -- disclosed in the class docstring, still absent from task_metadata.py. Across gpt2 / distilgpt2 / pythia-70m / pythia-160m at seed 42 the spread is real but n=4 with ties gives no usable correlation (mean_distinct_1 0.732-0.801, mean_self_bleu 0.047-0.075, sampling_entropy_first_quarter 2.073-2.250).
github_reason: Fetched utils/metrics/SelfBleu.py from geek-ai/Texygen master. calc_bleu is nltk.translate.bleu_score.sentence_bleu(reference, hypothesis, weight, smoothing_function=SmoothingFunction().method1) and get_bleu_parallel builds `other = reference[:i] + reference[i+1:]`, i.e. the same leave-one-out set BLME builds. Ran both on 60 random 6-completion sets of integer tokens: worst absolute difference 0.000e+00. Deviations from the reference that remain and are real: Texygen tokenizes with nltk.word_tokenize where BLME uses subword ids, and Texygen's class default is gram=3 where BLME fixes max_n=4 (4 is inside the Self-BLEU-2..5 set the paper reports).
paper_reason: Neither source paper publishes a number this task could reproduce. Zhu et al. 2018 Table 3-5 reports Self-BLEU for GAN text generators (SeqGAN, MaliGAN, RankGAN, TextGAN...) on the COCO Image Captions and EMNLP2017 News corpora -- not for a pretrained LM on eight hand-written English stems -- and Li et al. 2016 reports distinct-1/distinct-2 for conversation models on OpenSubtitles/Twitter. There is no published anchor for the entropy family at all: it is a BLME-designed diagnostic with no source paper.
confounds_reason: No architectural proxy found, and the top-50 warper actively removes the one that a full-vocabulary entropy would have: the sampling support is exactly 50 for every model, so the entropy cannot inherit a log(vocab) offset. n=4 (gpt2, distilgpt2, pythia-70m, pythia-160m) is too small and too tied for a meaningful rank correlation -- d_model takes only two values (512, 768) and vocab only two (50257, 50304) -- so the honest statement is that nothing points at d_model/n_layers/vocab, not that it has been excluded at n=66.
defects: REPRODUCIBILITY, CODE: the top-50 that the metric is now NAMED for is not set anywhere in BLME or in the model. generate_kwargs never passes top_k, model.generation_config.top_k reads None, and the 50 comes from transformers' internal _get_default_generation_params() (configuration_utils.py:547, transformers 5.2.0). Verified by ablation: with no top_k the support is 50; with top_k=0 or top_k=None it is 50257. So the estimand named in the column is pinned to an unversioned library default -- a transformers upgrade that changes it silently changes what mean_sampling_entropy_* means while the name stays true-sounding. Pass top_k=50 explicitly.

RE-RUN REQUIRED (already in RERUN_LEDGER.md): all three entropy columns are NaN in 66 of 66 stored result files (the pre-torch.special.entr bug), and they have now been renamed as well, so no stored run carries the current column names.

MINOR, CODE: the entropy family and the repetition family are computed over different sub-populations of completions than distinct-n. Entropy skips completions with valid_len < 4 and the token-repetition rate skips valid_len < 2, while distinct-n takes every completion, so the three means are averages over slightly different sets. Immaterial at max_new_tokens=32 but it is why mean_distinct_1 + _meta_mean_token_repetition_rate is exactly 1 only when no completion is dropped (measured 0.7829861 + 0.2170139 = 1.0 on gpt2).

CONFIG: 6 prompts x 6 completions x <= 32 new tokens = 36 short completions per model, and Self-BLEU over 5 references of <= 32 subword tokens is dominated by the method1 smoothing floor for the 3- and 4-gram precisions. The eight built-in prompts are hard-coded English sentence stems and nothing in the output records that the measured diversity is diversity on those stems.
